_: It.18 round-2: NPC repeatedly casts Candlelight on himself via the UseMagic procedure template. Round-1 in-game FAILED (mage stood but never cast) — root cause: I'd authored slot 3 (Spell) as PackageTargetObjectType+category-enum which produces a structurally-valid package the engine silently no-ops. All 46 vanilla UseMagic packages use PackageTargetObjectID with a FormLink to a specific SPEL. Round-2 fix: `spell` is now a SPEL ref, slot 4 defaults to PackageTargetSelf (vanilla pattern for self-cast). Candlelight (Skyrim.esm:0x043324) is a self-targeting Illusion spell that summons a glowing orb above the caster for ~60s — VISUALLY OBVIOUS in-game.

npcs.name: ModForge UseMagic Mage
npcs._spells: Add Candlelight to the NPC's known spells so he has it in his ActorEffect list (vanilla UseMagic packages tend to do this too — defensive belt-and-braces; the package's `spell` ref alone may suffice, but adding it here ensures the NPC actually 'knows' the spell).

packages._: UseMagic template (Skyrim.esm:0x0504F5). Round-2 (ObjectID + Self) made the orb APPEAR but only 1-2 times then stopped — root cause: `numToCastMax=2` is TOTAL casts for the package lifetime, not 'per cycle', AND schedule `durationInMinutes=0` lets the package complete the moment its cast quota's hit. Round-3 mirrors vanilla `WCollegeOnmundPracticeFlames` (NumToCast 1/1000 + Schedule durationMin=240): bump numToCastMax to 1000 and set durationInMinutes to 1440 (24h continuous) so the package keeps cycling forever.

placements._: Tamriel wilderness — same coords as the It.9 confirmed-working exterior placement. NPC stands here alone so nothing else interferes with package selection; tester walks up to find him.
